whatWePrint.heading: Tees, hoodies, bags & tumblers
whatWePrint.intro: Bring a sketch, a photo, a logo or just an idea. We'll put it on something you'll actually wear, carry or drink from.
whatWePrint.greatFor: gifts, businesses & brands, teams & clubs, family reunions, birthdays, bachelor and bachelorette trips, and memorials.

howItWorks.heading: From idea to ink
howItWorks.intro: Every order goes through the same four steps, so you know what you're getting before anything is printed.

steps.title: Tell us the idea
steps.text: Fill out the quote form or email us. Send any pictures or files you have.

steps.title: We design it
steps.text: We lay out your artwork and send you a proof to look over.

steps.title: You approve
steps.text: Ask for changes until it looks right. Nothing prints until you say go.

steps.title: We ink it
steps.text: Your order gets printed and we let you know when it's ready.

contact.heading: Email us
contact.intro: Questions, rush orders or just want to talk through an idea? Send us an email.
